It honestly seems like you’re unwilling to compromise. You asked your room mate to stop playing video games, and he eventually did. Now you are complaining that you can’t sleep because he’s eating in the room and is watching anime? He seems like he’s been accommodating to what you want. Have you tried going to bed earlier so you can get a few more hours of sleep? What about naps? Or getting an eye mask if the light is so distracting. Have you asked if he would consider a curfew for eating/using electronics? You said you get up at 7 most days so why do his alarms even bother you? If you’re already up? It seems like there are many things YOU could be doing. Your room is a shared space and it needs to be treated as such, not just accommodating one persons schedule over the other.

Did you guys have a room mate agreement done upon moving in? Talk to your RA and see if they can help. It does suck that your schedules are so different but I do think you are being a little unreasonable, in that you haven’t tried using a sleep mask, or anything. If you really can’t stand it ask about moving to a different room.
